assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single complete character reference for high-fidelity textured 3D mesh reconstruction. The attached image is the identity and costume reference, not an edit target. Recreate CAELAN DAWNSWORN as a magnificently sculpted, painterly-realistic premium fantasy game character, exactly coherent from his head through his feet. Preserve his rugged handsome mature angular face, short tousled dark hair, layered ivory-enamel and aged gold armor, indigo cloth, sun symbolism. This must feel like a masterfully authored game character statue, with the face painted in the SAME material and artistic style as the body, never a photographic face pasted on a simplified mannequin. The torso armor is a fitted three-dimensional cuirass that curves around the rib cage and tapers tightly at the waist, with a strong central keel, overlapping abdominal lames, sculpted sun-ray pauldrons wrapping the shoulders, properly volumetric gauntlets, sculpted knee guards, overlapping greaves and sabatons. Major forms read clearly before fine engraved ornament. Natural thick cloth folds and layered indigo waist panels, gold embroidery used sparingly. Genuine material contrast: aged matte ivory enamel, brushed dark gold edges, deep indigo fabric, dark brown glove leather. No chrome outlines, no wallpaper pattern, no rectangular flat armor plates. Heroic athletic anatomy with powerful shoulders, shaped thighs and calves, head at a natural 1:8 body height. Single full body on GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background. Straight front view, orthographic camera, anatomically neutral symmetrical A-pose with arms 25 degrees away from torso, elbows straight and hands relaxed open, feet slightly apart pointing forward, both soles on the same ground plane. No weapon and no long cape so arms, torso, hips and legs are fully visible and separable for rigging; retain short shoulder-cloak folds and the cloth waist panels. No pedestal, no ground, no cast shadow, no effects, no glow. Beautiful soft even diffuse studio light, neutral white balance, rich hand-painted shading that is consistent across face and armor. The character fills 88% of image height with generous margin around hands. Entire head and feet visible. No text, no second view, no collage.
